title: Grandma’s Story: The Mango Tree
moral: Parents always give selflessly—respect and care for them.

scenes.text: Grandma starts telling a story about Ravi and a mango tree.
scenes.image_prompt: grandmother telling story to kids at home cartoon

scenes.summary: Ravi grows and leaves the tree.
scenes.text: Ravi grows up and stops visiting the tree.
scenes.image_prompt: boy walking away from tree growing older cartoon

scenes.text: The tree gives mangoes and branches to help Ravi.
scenes.image_prompt: tree giving fruits and branches to boy cartoon

scenes.summary: Ravi returns as an old man.
scenes.text: Ravi comes back tired and old.
scenes.image_prompt: old man sitting near tree stump cartoon

scenes.text: Grandma explains the tree is like parents.
scenes.image_prompt: kids listening emotionally to grandma cartoon

story: A tree keeps giving everything to a boy throughout his life. In the end, it represents parents' selfless love.
